text:
Riley (AE): Customer pushed order form + redlined DPA. Wants HSM-backed keys for the POC and a 99.9% SLA. Asking to sign today. Can legal/infra/finance weigh in?
Priya (Legal): I can accept AES-256 at rest and limit processing purpose to evaluation. Subprocessor disclosure: propose 14 days notice (customer asked 7). SLA 99.9% needs SRE signoff and credits formula.
Noah (Finance): They sent PO: PO-2026-3344 and asked Net45 + split invoice (POC vs reserved). Net45 needs FP&A approval; split invoice ok if stated in order form.
Tess (Infra): HSM + VPC peering implies Private/Dedicated setup. Need CIDR, key format (PKCS#11/JSON), and qps/seq length. Expect 48-72 hours once we have details.
Viv (Security): Please attach SOC2 Type II and latest pentest. Confirm non-PHI. If PHI present we require HIPAA addendum. Also confirm TLS1.2+ and KMS model.
Riley (AE): Customer confirmed no PHI. Prefers parallel signing: procurement + finance first, exec parallel if available. Fallback: email approval + audit trail if exec delay >48h.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft a 1-page SLA addendum narrowing scope to the Dedicated inference pool used in POC, include AES-256 clause and mark subprocessor timing + credits as open.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created (env_7f3b2). Status: sent to procurement@cust and accounting@cust.
Noah (Finance): Once addendum attached and split-invoice clause present, I'll push FP&A for Net45 pre-approval. Route invoices to billing@redwood.com.
Tess (Infra): I'll open the private-deploy ticket as soon as CIDR + key format arrive and tag infra-oncall for key import.
Riley (AE): Action items: Priya draft addendum, Viv upload security docs to envelope, Tess wait for CIDR, Noah chase FP&A. I'll update thread when envelope completes. :thumbsup:
